Idempotente: headers ja presentes -> updated: false. Pre-condicoes ausentes viram {updated: false, reason} com exit 0. verbs.notes: Resolve a secao da fase no ROADMAP.md em duas passadas (milestone corrente, depois roadmap completo sem shipped) e tres fontes de lookup em ordem (exact -> numeric -> prefix-tolerant, #2121/#3599/#3537). Payload achado: found/phase_number/phase_name/goal/mode/success_criteria/section (mode lowercased, ex: mvp). Checklist sem secao de detalhe -> {found: false, error: 'malformed_roadmap', message}. Fase 999* e curto-circuito {found: false}. Call sites extraem --pick goal/mode/section. Roteado por routeRoadmapCommand ('get-phase') em src/roadmap-command-router.cts L143.

exit_codes.0: resolvido ou nao encontrado ({found: false}); malformed_roadmap tambem sai 0
